description: User-published agent skill packs: skills REST client and name and size validation, the skill packs store scoped to the current user and team workspace, and the catalog status, delete, and publish composables. The skills screen in the agent panel and the agent composer skill selection remain in the agent capability.

characterizationScenarios.name: Skills API lists, publishes, and deletes packs and the store scopes them to the active user and workspace
Skill pack form validates names and sizes and publishes packs

compatibilityPromises: Unclassified callers may import these internals during inventory; imports from classified domains remain subject to cross-domain rules.
The agent surfaces may keep importing skill pack internals during inventory.
skillPacksStore reading the current user and team workspace store, and skillsApi calling scripts/api, remain untracked coupling; classification does not grant dependency exceptions.
